test_box3d_overlap_naive: test the box3d_overlap_naive function to compute exact 3D box intersection volume and IoU
test_box3d_overlap_sampling: test the box3d_overlap_sampling function to compute approximate IoU via Monte Carlo point sampling
test_box_volume: test the box_volume function to compute the volume of a 3D box from its 8 corner vertices
test_box_planar_dir: test the box_planar_dir function to compute inward-pointing unit normal vectors for each box face
test_is_point_inside_box: test the is_point_inside_box function to determine whether 3D points lie inside a given box
